cookies.title: Your cookie choice
cookies.description: With your permission, TAMIR uses Google Analytics to measure visits and improve the store. Analytics is optional and remains off until you accept. You can reject it and continue shopping.
cookies.necessary: Essential storage keeps your cart, sign-in, language and cookie choice working. It stays enabled. Your choice is remembered for 180 days.
cookies.withdraw: You can withdraw consent by choosing Reject analytics. The page will reload to stop previously loaded analytics; unsaved form entries may be lost.
cookies.saveError: Your browser did not save the choice. Analytics will not be enabled without a saved acceptance. Check your cookie settings and try again.
